text:
Maria (Sales): Hey team — prepping an on‑prem POC for Acme. Fully air‑gapped site, 2‑week pilot. Their asks: offline installer, signed bundles/SBOM, HSM/KMS integration, upgrade cadence during POC, and a pro‑rated price for reserved nodes. Can SE + Security advise on feasibility and blockers?

Devin (SE): We can do this. Options: full immutable bundle or delta bundle updates via a jumpbox. We support SBOM + package signing. Need to confirm jumpbox pattern (ephemeral vs persistent) and their HSM type.

Jordan (Acme - CISO): RHEL8 hosts, no outbound. They have a Thales nShield HSM and require PKCS#11. For the POC they can provide an ephemeral jumpbox with limited network egress to our artifact transfer host.

Sam (SecEng): Thales + PKCS#11 is fine. For signing we can support a BYOK flow: signing agent runs inside the customer jumpbox and uses the HSM to sign bundles locally. Alternatively customer can sign and provide signed artifacts. For delta updates: requires a small stateful operator on the jumpbox to apply signed deltas. If they forbid any persistent agent, we must stick to full bundle installs.

Devin (SE): Upgrade cadence for POC: suggest baseline bundle + at most one hotfix during 2 weeks. Production cadence is typically monthly or quarterly. Rollback plan: install creates a new immutable release and we can revert to previous image if needed.

Anna (Legal): Pricing/contract note: POC credit covers 2 weeks of hosted API. On‑prem Private deployment incurs a platform fee + support time; if they want reserved Dedicated GPUs during pilot we pro‑rate monthly reserved pricing. They also asked for a short addendum around data handling for POC — will need legal review.

Maria (Sales): Customer also asked for an approximate daily rate for a small dedicated pool (2 x A100 equiv) so they can compare to self‑host. Can SE toss a ballpark?

Devin (SE): Ballpark only: small dedicated reserved pool ~ $XXX/day pro‑rated (depends on region/hardware and model throughput). I can run numbers if they share expected qps and model size. Note: on‑prem infra costs (power, racks) separate.

Jordan (Acme - CISO): They also require SBOM + SCA results and a CVE matrix for all third‑party libs shipped in the bundle. Can you produce that within the POC window?

Sam (SecEng): Yes. We can generate SBOMs and run a quick SCA scan. We’ll provide a signed SBOM (sig using the HSM/BYOK flow) and a CVE summary. Expect 3–4 business days to produce after we get access to the build artifacts.

Devin (SE): Who will provision the jumpbox and transport medium? We typically provide a checklist and simple scripts; customer ops usually hosts the jumpbox and we provide the tarball + signature to pull. Example snippet for install:

```bash
# on jumpbox
scp acme@transfer:/artifacts/redwood-bundle.tar.gz ./
sha256sum redwood-bundle.tar.gz
tar -xzf redwood-bundle.tar.gz
sudo systemctl start redwood-agent
```

Devin (SE): If they want fully offline bootstrap with USB transfer etc. we can support that but packaging needs deterministic checksums and signature verification.

Anna (Legal): Also logging/telemetry: they requested a pledge that no customer data leaves the site during POC. Our standard MSA covers telemetry opt‑out for Private deployments; addendum may be needed to explicitly disable any telemetry and confirm local logs stay on‑prem.

Maria (Sales): Jordan, can you confirm whether Acme will allow ephemeral jumpbox with the signing agent and whether they’re comfortable with the BYOK approach? Also confirm if they need an SBOM attestation format like SPDX or CycloneDX.

Jordan (Acme - CISO): They can provide ephemeral jumpbox and prefer CycloneDX for SBOMs. Thales nShield supports PKCS#11; they will coordinate with infra to enable signing. Telemetry must be disabled.

Sam (SecEng): Great — next steps: I’ll draft the signing/runbook + delta vs full bundle tradeoffs. SE to produce BOM and install snippets. Security to produce SBOM + SCA plan. Legal to draft the POC addendum about telemetry and data handling. Sales to confirm pricing ask and whether they want reserved GPUs during the pilot.

Devin (SE): I can have a first draft runbook and a pro‑forma BOM by EOD tomorrow.

Maria (Sales): Perfect. Jordan — if you can get the jumpbox details and a contact for their infra team, we’ll sync and schedule access. Thanks all :thumbsup:
